name: C. F. Brown
role: Partner in Coleman & Brown, Medora hotel
bio: C. F. Brown bought a lot in June 1884 to build a boarding house, and was a partner in Coleman & Brown, proprietors of the Medora hotel, until the firm dissolved in September 1884. In May 1885 a citizens' meeting appointed him to ask residents to clean up their premises.

moments.label: Appointed to request a town cleanup
